# Stored-data freeze, part (c) (refactor plan S3, invariant I16; OpenV REQ-89): the schema
# after Migrate on a fresh database (also what the first MigrateAndBackfill leaves, with no user yet).
# From pg_catalog, sorted by name: extensions, types, sequences, tables (row count, columns in
# column order, constraints, indexes, triggers), views, functions and the migration ledger.
# A line ending in @requires(x) exists only where extension x is installed; the plain postgres:15
# CI leg (no vector) expects those lines absent and every other line as written.
# Regenerate (a behavior change only) with every S3 golden, so that a new migration's body is frozen too,
# against a server with the vector and pg_trgm extensions:
# UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/persistence/postgres -count=1 -run '^(TestMigrationFreeze|TestEveryBootFreeze|TestSchemaGolden|TestPurgeCatalog)$'
extension pg_trgm  @requires(pg_trgm)
extension plpgsql
extension vector  @requires(vector)
sequence agent_run_logs_id_seq bigint start 1 increment 1 min 1 max 9223372036854775807 cache 1 owned by agent_run_logs.id
table agent_proposals rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column run_id uuid NOT NULL
  column project_id uuid NOT NULL
  column op character varying(32) NOT NULL
  column target_id uuid
  column payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column status character varying(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::character varying
  column review_note text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column applied_entity_id uuid
  column reviewed_by uuid
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column reviewed_at timestamp without time zone
  column ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  constraint agent_proposals_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint agent_proposals_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_proposals_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index agent_proposals_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_proposals_pkey ON public.agent_proposals USING btree (id)
  index idx_agent_proposals_project CREATE INDEX idx_agent_proposals_project ON public.agent_proposals USING btree (project_id)
  index idx_agent_proposals_run CREATE INDEX idx_agent_proposals_run ON public.agent_proposals USING btree (run_id)
  index idx_agent_proposals_status CREATE INDEX idx_agent_proposals_status ON public.agent_proposals USING btree (status, project_id)
table agent_run_logs rows 0
  column id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('agent_run_logs_id_seq'::regclass)
  column run_id uuid NOT NULL
  column seq integer NOT NULL
  column kind character varying(32) NOT NULL
  column payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint agent_run_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint agent_run_logs_run_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_run_logs_run_id_seq_key UNIQUE (run_id, seq)
  index agent_run_logs_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_run_logs_pkey ON public.agent_run_logs USING btree (id)
  index agent_run_logs_run_id_seq_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_run_logs_run_id_seq_key ON public.agent_run_logs USING btree (run_id, seq)
  index idx_agent_run_logs_run CREATE INDEX idx_agent_run_logs_run ON public.agent_run_logs USING btree (run_id, seq)
table agent_runs rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column agent_id uuid NOT NULL
  column project_id uuid
  column automation_id uuid
  column trigger_event_id uuid
  column team_id uuid
  column team_node_id uuid
  column parent_run_id uuid
  column work_item_id uuid
  column interview_session_id uuid
  column guided_session_id uuid
  column status character varying(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'::character varying
  column cancel_requested boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column priority integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column prompt text NOT NULL
  column run_token_hash character varying(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column worker_id character varying(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column heartbeat_at timestamp without time zone
  column started_at timestamp without time zone
  column finished_at timestamp without time zone
  column exit_code integer
  column final_text text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column error text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column tokens_in bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column tokens_out bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column cost_usd numeric(10,4)
  column artifacts_touched jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  column launched_by uuid
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column org_id uuid
  column preferred_user_id uuid
  column hosted_after timestamp without time zone
  column retried_from_run_id uuid
  column error_class character varying(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column attempt_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  column max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  column next_attempt_at timestamp without time zone
  column agent_content_hash character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column agent_model character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column agent_effort character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column partial_text text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column claimed_by uuid
  constraint agent_runs_agent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_runs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint agent_runs_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  index agent_runs_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_runs_pkey ON public.agent_runs USING btree (id)
  index idx_agent_runs_agent_id CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_agent_id ON public.agent_runs USING btree (agent_id)
  index idx_agent_runs_automation CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_automation ON public.agent_runs USING btree (automation_id, created_at)
  index idx_agent_runs_created_at CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_created_at ON public.agent_runs USING btree (created_at)
  index idx_agent_runs_launched_by CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_launched_by ON public.agent_runs USING btree (launched_by)
  index idx_agent_runs_org CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_org ON public.agent_runs USING btree (org_id, created_at)
  index idx_agent_runs_parent CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_parent ON public.agent_runs USING btree (parent_run_id)
  index idx_agent_runs_project_id CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_project_id ON public.agent_runs USING btree (project_id)
  index idx_agent_runs_queued_claim CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_queued_claim ON public.agent_runs USING btree (org_id, priority DESC, created_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'queued'::text)
  index idx_agent_runs_status CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_status ON public.agent_runs USING btree (status)
  index idx_agent_runs_token_hash CREATE INDEX idx_agent_runs_token_hash ON public.agent_runs USING btree (run_token_hash)
table agent_team_edges rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column team_id uuid NOT NULL
  column from_node_id uuid NOT NULL
  column to_node_id uuid NOT NULL
  column edge_type character varying(32) NOT NULL
  column config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint agent_team_edges_from_node_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (team_id, from_node_id) REFERENCES agent_team_nodes(team_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_team_edges_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint agent_team_edges_team_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES agent_teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_team_edges_team_id_from_node_id_to_node_id_edge_type_key UNIQUE (team_id, from_node_id, to_node_id, edge_type)
  constraint agent_team_edges_to_node_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (team_id, to_node_id) REFERENCES agent_team_nodes(team_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index agent_team_edges_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_team_edges_pkey ON public.agent_team_edges USING btree (id)
  index agent_team_edges_team_id_from_node_id_to_node_id_edge_type_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_team_edges_team_id_from_node_id_to_node_id_edge_type_key ON public.agent_team_edges USING btree (team_id, from_node_id, to_node_id, edge_type)
  index idx_agent_team_edges_from CREATE INDEX idx_agent_team_edges_from ON public.agent_team_edges USING btree (from_node_id, edge_type)
  index idx_agent_team_edges_team CREATE INDEX idx_agent_team_edges_team ON public.agent_team_edges USING btree (team_id)
table agent_team_nodes rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column team_id uuid NOT NULL
  column agent_id uuid
  column label character varying(255) NOT NULL
  column department character varying(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column position jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column node_type character varying(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent'::character varying
  column user_id uuid
  constraint agent_team_nodes_agent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_team_nodes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint agent_team_nodes_team_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES agent_teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint agent_team_nodes_team_id_id_key UNIQUE (team_id, id)
  constraint agent_team_nodes_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint chk_crew_node_identity CHECK (((((node_type)::text = 'agent'::text) AND (agent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (user_id IS NULL)) OR (((node_type)::text = 'human'::text) AND (user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (agent_id IS NULL))))
  index agent_team_nodes_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_team_nodes_pkey ON public.agent_team_nodes USING btree (id)
  index agent_team_nodes_team_id_id_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_team_nodes_team_id_id_key ON public.agent_team_nodes USING btree (team_id, id)
  index idx_agent_team_nodes_agent CREATE INDEX idx_agent_team_nodes_agent ON public.agent_team_nodes USING btree (agent_id)
  index idx_agent_team_nodes_team CREATE INDEX idx_agent_team_nodes_team ON public.agent_team_nodes USING btree (team_id)
table agent_teams rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column name character varying(512) NOT NULL
  column description text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column project_id uuid
  column entry_node_id uuid
  column is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column org_id uuid
  constraint agent_teams_entry_node_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (entry_node_id) REFERENCES agent_team_nodes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  constraint agent_teams_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint agent_teams_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index agent_teams_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agent_teams_pkey ON public.agent_teams USING btree (id)
  index idx_agent_teams_entry_node CREATE INDEX idx_agent_teams_entry_node ON public.agent_teams USING btree (entry_node_id) WHERE (entry_node_id IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_agent_teams_project CREATE INDEX idx_agent_teams_project ON public.agent_teams USING btree (project_id)
table agents rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column slug character varying(128) NOT NULL
  column name character varying(512) NOT NULL
  column description text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column provider character varying(64) NOT NULL
  column model character varying(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column effort character varying(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column allowed_tools jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  column write_mode character varying(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposal'::character varying
  column repo_access boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column max_turns integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 50
  column timeout_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800
  column config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column locked boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column system_prompt text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column file_path character varying(1024) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column content_hash character varying(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column synced_at timestamp without time zone
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column org_id uuid
  constraint agents_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index agents_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX agents_pkey ON public.agents USING btree (id)
  index idx_agents_org_slug CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_agents_org_slug ON public.agents USING btree (org_id, slug)
  index idx_agents_slug_lookup CREATE INDEX idx_agents_slug_lookup ON public.agents USING btree (slug)
table artifact_embeddings rows 0  @requires(vector)
  column artifact_id uuid NOT NULL  @requires(vector)
  column artifact_version integer NOT NULL  @requires(vector)
  column embedding vector(1536) NOT NULL  @requires(vector)
  column model character varying NOT NULL  @requires(vector)
  column content_hash character varying NOT NULL  @requires(vector)
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()  @requires(vector)
  constraint artifact_embeddings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (artifact_id)  @requires(vector)
  index artifact_embeddings_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artifact_embeddings_pkey ON public.artifact_embeddings USING btree (artifact_id)  @requires(vector)
  index idx_artifact_embeddings_hnsw CREATE INDEX idx_artifact_embeddings_hnsw ON public.artifact_embeddings USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)  @requires(vector)
table artifact_ref_counters rows 0
  column project_id uuid NOT NULL
  column prefix character varying(16) NOT NULL
  column next_num integer NOT NULL
  constraint artifact_ref_counters_pkey PRIMARY KEY (project_id, prefix)
  constraint artifact_ref_counters_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index artifact_ref_counters_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artifact_ref_counters_pkey ON public.artifact_ref_counters USING btree (project_id, prefix)
table artifacts rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column project_id uuid NOT NULL
  column parent_id uuid
  column type character varying(255) NOT NULL
  column title character varying(512) NOT NULL
  column body text
  column sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column attributes jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  column valid_from timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column valid_to timestamp without time zone
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column created_by uuid
  column status character varying(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'::character varying
  column ref character varying(32)
  constraint artifacts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id, version)
  constraint artifacts_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index artifacts_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX artifacts_pkey ON public.artifacts USING btree (id, version)
  index idx_artifacts_body_trgm CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_body_trgm ON public.artifacts USING gin (body gin_trgm_ops)  @requires(pg_trgm)
  index idx_artifacts_id_active CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_artifacts_id_active ON public.artifacts USING btree (id) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_artifacts_owner CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_owner ON public.artifacts USING btree (project_id, ((attributes ->> 'owner'::text))) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_artifacts_parent_id CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_parent_id ON public.artifacts USING btree (parent_id)
  index idx_artifacts_project_active CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_project_active ON public.artifacts USING btree (project_id) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_artifacts_project_id CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_project_id ON public.artifacts USING btree (project_id)
  index idx_artifacts_project_ref CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_artifacts_project_ref ON public.artifacts USING btree (project_id, ref) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_artifacts_project_status CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_project_status ON public.artifacts USING btree (project_id, status) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_artifacts_sort_order CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_sort_order ON public.artifacts USING btree (sort_order)
  index idx_artifacts_title_trgm CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_title_trgm ON public.artifacts USING gin (title gin_trgm_ops)  @requires(pg_trgm)
  index idx_artifacts_type CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_type ON public.artifacts USING btree (type)
  index idx_artifacts_valid_to CREATE INDEX idx_artifacts_valid_to ON public.artifacts USING btree (valid_to)

table attachment_versions rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column attachment_id uuid NOT NULL
  column version integer NOT NULL
  column filename character varying(512) NOT NULL
  column original_filename character varying(512) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column mime_type character varying(128) NOT NULL
  column file_path character varying(1024) NOT NULL
  column file_size integer NOT NULL
  column created_by uuid
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column title character varying(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column restored_from integer
  constraint attachment_versions_attachment_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (attachment_id) REFERENCES attachments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint attachment_versions_attachment_id_version_key UNIQUE (attachment_id, version)
  constraint attachment_versions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index attachment_versions_attachment_id_version_key CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attachment_versions_attachment_id_version_key ON public.attachment_versions USING btree (attachment_id, version)
  index attachment_versions_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attachment_versions_pkey ON public.attachment_versions USING btree (id)
  index idx_attachment_versions_attachment CREATE INDEX idx_attachment_versions_attachment ON public.attachment_versions USING btree (attachment_id, version DESC)
table attachments rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column artifact_id uuid
  column filename character varying(512) NOT NULL
  column mime_type character varying(128) NOT NULL
  column file_path character varying(1024) NOT NULL
  column file_size integer NOT NULL
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column figure_ref character varying(64)
  column figure_num integer
  column version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  column original_filename character varying(512) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column title character varying(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  constraint attachments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index attachments_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attachments_pkey ON public.attachments USING btree (id)
  index idx_attachments_artifact_figure_ref CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_attachments_artifact_figure_ref ON public.attachments USING btree (artifact_id, figure_ref) WHERE (figure_ref IS NOT NULL)
  index idx_attachments_artifact_id CREATE INDEX idx_attachments_artifact_id ON public.attachments USING btree (artifact_id)
table attribute_definitions rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column org_id uuid
  column project_id uuid
  column key character varying(64) NOT NULL
  column label text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column data_type character varying(16) NOT NULL
  column enum_values jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  column applies_to_type character varying(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  column created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  constraint attribute_definitions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint attribute_definitions_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index attribute_definitions_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attribute_definitions_pkey ON public.attribute_definitions USING btree (id)
  index idx_attribute_definitions_org CREATE INDEX idx_attribute_definitions_org ON public.attribute_definitions USING btree (org_id) WHERE (project_id IS NULL)
  index idx_attribute_definitions_project CREATE INDEX idx_attribute_definitions_project ON public.attribute_definitions USING btree (project_id) WHERE (project_id IS NOT NULL)
table automations rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column name character varying(512) NOT NULL
  column agent_id uuid
  column team_id uuid
  column project_id uuid
  column kind character varying(32) NOT NULL
  column enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  column prompt_template text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  column cron_expr character varying(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column catch_up boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  column next_run_at timestamp without time zone
  column last_run_at timestamp without time zone
  column event_type character varying(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::character varying
  column event_filter jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column cooldown_seconds integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 60
  column max_runs_per_hour integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 10
  column created_by uuid
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column org_id uuid
  constraint automations_agent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (agent_id) REFERENCES agents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  constraint automations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  constraint automations_project_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  index automations_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX automations_pkey ON public.automations USING btree (id)
  index idx_automations_event CREATE INDEX idx_automations_event ON public.automations USING btree (event_type) WHERE (enabled AND ((kind)::text = 'triggered'::text))
  index idx_automations_next_run CREATE INDEX idx_automations_next_run ON public.automations USING btree (next_run_at) WHERE (enabled AND ((kind)::text = 'scheduled'::text))
  index idx_automations_project CREATE INDEX idx_automations_project ON public.automations USING btree (project_id)

  index idx_email_verifications_token CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_email_verifications_token ON public.email_verifications USING btree (token_hash)

table links rows 0
  column id uuid NOT NULL
  column from_id uuid NOT NULL
  column to_id uuid NOT NULL
  column type character varying(255) NOT NULL
  column attributes jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  column version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  column created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column updated_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column valid_from timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  column valid_to timestamp without time zone
  column suspect boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  constraint links_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  index idx_links_from_active CREATE INDEX idx_links_from_active ON public.links USING btree (from_id) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_links_from_id CREATE INDEX idx_links_from_id ON public.links USING btree (from_id)
  index idx_links_suspect CREATE INDEX idx_links_suspect ON public.links USING btree (suspect) WHERE ((valid_to IS NULL) AND suspect)
  index idx_links_to_active CREATE INDEX idx_links_to_active ON public.links USING btree (to_id) WHERE (valid_to IS NULL)
  index idx_links_to_id CREATE INDEX idx_links_to_id ON public.links USING btree (to_id)
  index idx_links_type CREATE INDEX idx_links_type ON public.links USING btree (type)
  index idx_links_valid_to CREATE INDEX idx_links_valid_to ON public.links USING btree (valid_to)
  index links_pkey CREATE UNIQUE INDEX links_pkey ON public.links USING btree (id)
